title: WHOOP Recovery Mismatch With Sleep Score
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports, Oura, WHOOP, Dexcom, Levels, LibreView, Eight Sleep, Withings, and Garmin Body Battery feeds via vendor APIs, exports, Home Assistant bridges, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=whoop:cycle
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(recovery_pct) as recovery_pct, avg(sleep_score) as sleep_score by athlete _time
| where sleep_score>80 AND recovery_pct<40
| sort recovery_pct
description: Uses WHOOP daily recovery telemetry to monitor days where sleep looked strong but recovery stayed poor in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for hidden stress or illness signals that sleep duration alone missed, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest WHOOP daily recovery data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Daily comparison of sleep score and recovery percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It records days where sleep looked strong but recovery stayed poor so you can spot hidden stress or illness signals that sleep duration alone missed before it becomes annoying.
